items.title: Claude Code: convert Quo comms ledger from daily batch to inbound webhook
items.step: Share 📇 Operational Comms Ledger with Notion connection n8n-cos, point public HTTPS at http://127.0.0.1:5678/webhook/quo-comms-ledger, then register that HTTPS URL in Quo Settings → Webhooks per WEBHOOK-REGISTRATION.md (~20 minutes).
items.why_machine_cannot: every one of these asks is reachable through the n8n REST API; the queue has no N8N_API_KEY, so the work is blocked on supplying that one credential rather than on browser interaction

items.title: Claude Code: restore metabase-reader impersonation so BigQuery reads stop running as the writer identity
items.step: GATE: external IAM authority. Needs roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for dbt-prod-runner ON the metabase-reader service account in project forged-data. The machine identity cannot grant itself token-creator on another principal, and it cannot list IAM to verify one, so this is a genuine authorization boundary and not a scheduling question. Everything machine-side is already done: the capability is configured for impersonation (impersonate_reads=true) and falls back correctly today, so the change is a single IAM binding plus a preflight re-run. NOT urgent -- the current path works, this is defence in depth.
items.why_machine_cannot: granting an IAM role on a service account in another project requires an account with that project admin authority; no credential on this host carries it

items.title: n8n: migrate Plaud captures sync off cloud Cowork (poll + Note ID dedupe + Captures write)

items.title: 13WCF v3 #4: render PDF, create partner draft, notify via Telegram

items.why_machine_cannot: Google OAuth consent requires an interactive browser sign-in as the account owner; a refresh token cannot be minted headlessly
